Product.title: Product
Product.description: A toy shop inventory item with pricing, stock level, barcode, compressed photos, and optional merchandising details.

ownerId.description: UID of the shop owner who owns this inventory item.

name.description: Display name of the toy product.

barcode.description: Optional unique barcode digits for USB scanner lookup and label printing.

category.description: Free-text product category suggested from previously used categories.

sellingPrice.description: Retail selling price in the shop currency (e.g. IQD whole numbers).

costPrice.description: Wholesale unit cost price in the shop currency.

quantityInStock.description: Current on-hand unit count (may become negative when oversold at the counter).

reorderLevel.description: Optional low-stock threshold; items at or below this count are flagged low stock.

photos.description: List of product photo URLs or compressed JPEG data URLs.

variantLabel.description: Optional size, color, or edition label.

isArchived.description: Soft-archive flag so historical sales records are preserved.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the product was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the product was last modified.

StockMovement.title: StockMovement
StockMovement.description: Immutable ledger record for every stock quantity change from restock, removal, sale, or voided sale.

productName.description: Snapshot of the product name at the time of the stock change.

quantityChange.description: Signed quantity delta (positive for add/void, negative for remove/sale).

note.description: Optional note about the shipment, damage, sale, or void.

costPrice.description: Optional unit cost price recorded when adding stock.

saleId.description: Optional linked sale document ID for sale or void movements.

Sale.title: Sale
Sale.description: Cash-only counter sale with immutable line item snapshots (list price, sold price, cost price) and void support.

items.description: Sold line items capturing product, quantity, listPrice, unitPrice, costPrice, and lineTotal.

totalAmount.description: Total cash sale amount actually charged.

totalCost.description: Total wholesale cost snapshot at the time of sale.

note.description: Optional free-text note for end-of-day reconciliation (e.g. FIB transfer).

status.description: Sale lifecycle state; voided sales restore stock and remain archived.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the sale completed.

voidedAt.description: Server timestamp when the sale was voided.

ShopSettings.title: ShopSettings
ShopSettings.description: Shop display name and currency preferences for the counter inventory app.

ownerId.description: UID of the shop user who initialized settings.

shopName.description: Name of the toy shop shown in the app header and printed labels.

currency.description: Currency code or label shown next to prices (e.g. IQD).

weekStartDay.description: Day of week reports start on (0=Sunday through 6=Saturday; defaults to 6=Saturday).

User.title: User
User.description: Authorized Google account record keyed by lowercase email address.

displayName.description: Display name of the authorized user.

role.description: Access role; both roles access all shop features, only admin manages users.

active.description: Whether the user currently has access to the store.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user was added.

updatedAt.description: Optional server timestamp when the user record was last modified.

/users/{userEmail}.description: Authorized shop users keyed by lowercase Google email address.

/products/{productId}.description: Shop toy products catalog and live stock levels.

/sales/{saleId}.description: Counter cash sales history and reconciliation records.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Shop configuration document (e.g. shop name and currency).
